summary: Three layers (sky, ridge, foreground) plus a caption move at different speeds while the container scrolls, so the scene gains depth. Native scroll timeline, with a scroll listener fallback.
use: Hero images, editorial headers, product storytelling: any pinned scene where background should move slower than foreground.
spec: `MotionStage` from `@codeatlasdev/ui` with `loop={6200}`: autoplay scrolls the container, a wheel or touch scroll takes over
A sticky scene inside a taller scroller: `position: sticky;` on `.scene__sticky` and `block-size: 26rem;` on `.scene__track`
Layer travel at full scroll: sky `-6%`, ridge `-22%`, foreground `-48%`, caption `30%` while fading to opacity `0.15`
Fallback without support: a `scroll` listener writes progress to `--p` and the transforms read `translateY(calc(var(--p) * -22%))`
Under reduced motion `--p` is `1` and nothing moves (`.scene--final`)

motion.property: transform: translateY to 30% and opacity to 0.15, caption
